featured.title: Guillermo Rauch · Vercel CEO
featured.summaryEn: Vercel CEO Guillermo Rauch introduced gdp-ts (Ghosts of Departed Proofs for TypeScript), a library, linter and AI skill for safer API design. Sensitive functions require "proofs" that the caller performed an authorization check, and the typechecker verifies them at compile time, preventing teams and agents from shipping catastrophic security bugs. These patterns have long existed in ecosystems like Haskell but stayed niche due to human review costs and cognitive/syntactic overhead. Rauch argues the situation is no…
featured.insightZh: Vercel CEO Guillermo Rauch 发布了开源项目 gdp-ts（Ghosts of Departed Proofs for TypeScript）：一个库 + linter + AI skill，用来做更安全的 API 设计。核心机制是让敏感函数强制要求调用方出示“证明”，证明自己已经做过授权检查，并由类型检查器在编译期验证，从而在源头拦截灾难性的安全漏洞。这类模式在 Haskell 生态早已存在，但过去因为人工代码评审成本和语法/认知负担一直很小众。Rauch 的判断是局面已经反转：Agent 写代码的速度已经超过人类评审能力，而 Agent 恰恰在“硬约束 + 紧反馈循环”里表现最好——这也是 Rust 和借用检查器兴起的同一逻辑。README 示例取自 Vercel 真实场景：修改 Project 密码需要同时证明特定角色和特定权益。对企业交付的启示：在 Agent 大规模写代码的时代，安全护栏应从“人工评审”前移到“编译期强制”。

featured.title: Aaron Levie · Box CEO
featured.summaryEn: Box CEO Aaron Levie notes that much of agent adoption is bottlenecked by the ability to test, tune and optimize agents on "real" work environments — the files, CRM systems, email and more that agents need to access. You can't know how agents are performing without understanding how they execute on your evals and how they'll behave after a model change or workflow upgrade. Today every enterprise does this one by one, which is slow and tedious. He expects every enterprise to have someone managing evals, plus infrast…
featured.insightZh: Box CEO Aaron Levie 指出，相当一部分 Agent 的落地被“无法在真实工作环境中测试、调优”卡住——Agent 需要访问的文件、CRM、邮件等环境。如果不了解 Agent 在你自己的 evals 上表现如何、换模型或升级工作流后会怎样，就无法判断它是否靠谱。目前每家企业都只能一家一家自己做，又慢又繁琐。他预判每个企业都会有专人负责 evals，并需要构建和运行 evals、仿真环境的基础设施——这是一个巨大的市场。

items.insightZh: Box CEO Aaron Levie 指出，相当一部分 Agent 的落地被“无法在真实工作环境中测试、调优”卡住——Agent 需要访问的文件、CRM、邮件等环境。如果不了解 Agent 在你自己的 evals 上表现如何、换模型或升级工作流后会怎样，就无法判断它是否靠谱。目前每家企业都只能一家一家自己做，又慢又繁琐。他预判每个企业都会有专人负责 evals，并需要构建和运行 evals、仿真环境的基础设施——这是一个巨大的市场。

items.title: Madhu Guru · Meta AI 高级总监（前 Google Gemini/Veo/Nano Banana 负责人）
items.summaryEn: Meta Sr Director of AI and former Google Gemini/Veo/Nano Banana lead Madhu Guru says the most common mistake teams make is treating evals as an additional QA step after the agent is built. AI products are fundamentally different: your evals are your product spec.
items.insightZh: Meta AI 高级总监、前 Google Gemini / Veo / Nano Banana 负责人 Madhu Guru 一针见血：团队最常犯的错误，是把 evals 当成 Agent 做完之后额外加的 QA 步骤。AI 产品本质上不同——你的 evals 就是你的产品规格说明书。与上面 Levie 的观点形成呼应：evals 正在从测试环节升级为产品定义本身。

items.title: Thariq · Anthropic Claude Code
items.summaryEn: Thariq from Anthropic's Claude Code team shared that planning in this structured way is much more token-efficient than raw HTML — the model doesn't need to remake components or logic for common things like state machines, diagrams and code snippets. His favorite name for another pattern is "local hands": Claude runs in the cloud but can access your local files, a capability also coming to Cowork. He also pointed to good resources for getting into game design.
items.insightZh: Anthropic Claude Code 团队的 Thariq 分享了几点：一是用结构化方式做规划，比直接生成原始 HTML 更省 token——模型无需反复重建状态机、图表、代码片段等常见组件和逻辑；二是他最喜欢的一个模式命名叫 “local hands”：Claude 在云端运行，但能访问你本地的文件，这一能力也将进入 Cowork；此外还推荐了一些学习游戏设计的资源。

items.title: Garry Tan · Y Combinator 总裁兼 CEO
items.summaryEn: YC President & CEO Garry Tan argues that lab-built harnesses have an incentive to burn tokens, so startup harnesses have real utility — e.g. Grep can automatically swap token burn into deterministic, tested, repeatable code just by observing agent use. He also says AGI Science Loops are coming, with Halmos building tooling for them.
items.insightZh: YC 总裁兼 CEO Garry Tan 认为：大模型厂商自带的 harness 有“烧 token”的动机，因此创业公司做的 harness 有真实价值——例如 Grep 能通过观察 Agent 的使用，把消耗 token 的操作自动替换为确定性、经过测试、可重复的代码。他还预言 “AGI 科学循环（AGI Science Loops）” 即将到来，并提到 Halmos 正在为其构建相应工具。

items.title: Amjad Masad · Replit CEO
items.summaryEn: Replit CEO Amjad Masad says the US is catching up on open-weights models, and he's proud of how many family-run businesses are powered by Replit. He also showcased an agent use case: "Promote my app on TikTok."
items.insightZh: Replit CEO Amjad Masad 表示，美国在开源权重模型上正在追赶；同时为大量家族经营的小生意跑在 Replit 上感到自豪，并展示了“帮我在 TikTok 上推广我的 App”这类面向非技术用户的 Agent 场景。

items.title: Ryo Lu · 前 Cursor 设计负责人
items.summaryEn: Ryo Lu, who designed for Cursor, Notion and Stripe, wrote a tribute to Steve Jobs: seeing the iMac G4 as a kid got him into interface design, making his PC look like a Mac because he couldn't afford one. He feels the industry has been stuck in a loop of constant refinement since Jobs died — faster, thinner, more cameras, more ways to keep people scrolling — while people grow more disconnected; he wishes we spent less energy beating humans and more making their lives better. He also shipped ryOS Subtitles for Chrom…
items.insightZh: 曾为 Cursor、Notion、Stripe 做设计的 Ryo Lu 写了一篇纪念乔布斯的长文：少年时被 iMac G4 震撼，买不起 Mac 就把 PC 改成 Mac 的样子，由此入行界面设计。他感慨乔布斯离世后行业陷入“不断微调”的循环——更快、更薄、更多摄像头、更会让人刷个不停，人却更孤独；他希望少花精力“打败人类”，多花精力让人的生活更好。另外他还发布了一个小工具：在 Netflix 上同时显示任意两种语言字幕，并为日、中、韩文提供发音标注（Chrome 插件 ryOS Subtitles）。

items.title: Peter Yang · AI 教程创作者
items.summaryEn: AI tutorials creator Peter Yang released a new tutorial on building an AI language-learning app that teaches Japanese via live voice calls: using his spec skill to create key designs, setting up Gemini Live APIs for voice, and creating diorama art with Nano Banana. Follow along to learn 100 phrases in any language before a trip.
items.insightZh: AI 教程创作者 Peter Yang 发布新教程：他做了一个通过实时语音通话教日语的 AI 语言学习 App，演示了如何用自己的 spec skill 产出关键设计、接入 Gemini Live API 做语音、用 Nano Banana 生成立体模型风格插画。跟着做可以在出行前学会任意语言的 100 个常用句。

items.title: Thibault Sottiaux · OpenAI Codex & ChatGPT
items.summaryEn: Thibault Sottiaux of OpenAI Codex & ChatGPT said this might have been his best day so far at OpenAI, and highlighted Sergio's work on a collaborative space right inside ChatGPT, improving by leaps and bounds every day.
items.insightZh: OpenAI Codex & ChatGPT 负责人 Thibault Sottiaux 称这可能是他在 OpenAI 最棒的一天，强度和乐趣都拉满；并点名同事 Sergio 正在 ChatGPT 内打造协作空间（collaborative space），每天都在大幅进步。

items.title: Aditya Agarwal · South Park Commons 普通合伙人、前 Dropbox CTO
items.summaryEn: SPC General Partner and former Dropbox CTO Aditya Agarwal announced that Sergey Levine — Berkeley EECS faculty and Physical Intelligence co-founder, who builds algorithms letting robots learn from experience — is coming to SPC. He also mused that running the Muse/Dot "computer" locally could be a better agent environment than the increasingly locked-down macOS.
items.insightZh: SPC 普通合伙人、前 Dropbox CTO Aditya Agarwal 预告 Physical Intelligence 联合创始人、伯克利 EECS 教授 Sergey Levine 将到访 SPC——他研究让机器人从经验中学习、把视觉与动作关联的算法。他还提出一个想法：如果能在本地运行 Muse/Dot 的“计算机”会很有意思，这可能比日益封闭的 macOS 更适合作为 Agent 运行环境。
